allocation_design.execution: candidates run sequentially within each allocation using their exact retained checkpoint and resolved model mapping
allocation_design.hardware_and_runtime_identity: exactly the expanded-search frozen runtime identity
allocation_design.incomplete_allocation_policy: Exclude the entire allocation and rerun the complete front under a new TAO job ID; never combine a partial block.
allocation_design.independence: six distinct TAO SDK jobs and SLURM allocations
allocation_design.matching: Every allocation benchmarks every global rank-zero candidate exactly once on the same node; candidate-pair differences are matched within allocation.

candidate_set.missing_checkpoint_policy: report blocked; never substitute or manually promote another candidate
candidate_set.rule: Include every valid candidate whose global pareto_rank is exactly zero, regardless of mode winner status, candidate ID, parameter values, or expected desirability.
candidate_set.source: expanded_combined_selection.json produced by tao_automl.selection.analyze_archive over the complete shared archive

ordering.audit: Record canonical candidate IDs, every design-row index used, all six candidate orders, position counts, immediate ordered-adjacency counts, and a canonical schedule SHA256.
ordering.base_row: For n canonical candidates, form index order [0,1,n-1,2,n-2,3,n-3,...] without duplicates until all n indices appear.
ordering.design_rows: Create n modulo-addition rotations of the base row. If n is odd, append the reversal of each rotation, giving 2n design rows.
ordering.determinism: Candidate IDs, n, allocation index, and this formula are the only ordering inputs; observed objectives and measurements are forbidden inputs.
ordering.selected_rows: Let R be the design-row count. Allocation k in [0,5] uses design row floor(k*R/6).

paired_analysis.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap resampling the six allocation-level differences with replacement
paired_analysis.comparison_set: all unordered pairs of global rank-zero candidates
paired_analysis.equivalence_rule: Report practical equivalence when the complete paired 95 percent CI lies within the plus-or-minus practical tolerance band; otherwise report uncertainty.
paired_analysis.estimator: median of the six allocation-level paired differences, first candidate minus second candidate
paired_analysis.stable_difference_rule: Claim a relative latency direction only when the paired 95 percent CI lies wholly below negative practical tolerance or wholly above positive practical tolerance.

contract.purpose: Measure allocation-stable relative latency for every algorithmic global Pareto-front candidate without changing the frozen selection.

selection_isolation.allowed_use: stability analysis and hypothesis verdict only

search.selection_population: unchanged union of every successful finite measured candidate

accuracy.reason: Highest valid accuracy; accuracy-equivalent ties use lower stabilized latency then canonical configuration hash.

latency.reason: Lowest stabilized latency among candidates satisfying the accuracy-winner-relative constraint; statistically equivalent latencies use higher accuracy then canonical configuration hash.

multi_objective.reason: Minimum front-normalized augmented-Chebyshev regret on the multi-objective-eligible Pareto front selected a distinct compromise.
